approval.heading: Review and approve
approval.intro: Approve the plan to start work. Approve the tested release when it is ready. No command comments needed.
approval.empty: No approvals are waiting for you. Check the work status below.
approval.plan_summary: Review the scope below. Approval starts work on this plan.
approval.release_summary: Review the completed changes below. Automated checks and QA remain required.
approval.publishing_disabled: Approval will be recorded. Publishing awaits deployment configuration.
approval.account: Approvals are available only to the configured founder. Sign in with that GitHub account on this computer.
approval.unavailable: Approval buttons will be available after the dashboard approval workflow is installed on main.
approval.requested: Approval requested. Waiting for the controller to confirm.
approval.failed: The approval workflow failed. Open its result, then retry after the issue is resolved.
approval.stale: This version changed. Refresh and review the latest version before approving.
approval.error.invalid_session: Your dashboard session changed. Refresh the page before approving.
approval.error.founder_required: Approval is unavailable for this account or controller version. Refresh and check your founder sign-in.
approval.error.approval_changed: This approval changed or was already recorded. Refresh the dashboard before trying again.
approval.error.dispatch_failed: The approval request could not be sent. Check your connection and try again.
